assertions_evaluated.text: Repair is modeled as appending a NEW evidence entry whose own `supersedes` field names the earlier entry's evidence_id, never editing or deleting the earlier entry itself
assertions_evaluated.evidence: 'supersedes: E_old — the only field that links back to the entry being corrected; E_old itself is left completely untouched (no edit, no deletion)' — the procedure is described as appending a brand-new entry with a full field list, never mutating the prior one.

assertions_evaluated.text: Repair never touches GitHub state directly — GitHub is read only to verify the current state, never mutated
assertions_evaluated.evidence: 'Never touch GitHub state to "fix" anything there, never write back to correct GitHub's own native Linear integration...' — explicit statement; all GitHub calls performed/planned (gh pr view, git ls-remote) are read-only.

assertions_evaluated.text: Never resolves the stale entry by newest-timestamp comparison; correction is toward GitHub's actual current state, since GitHub is authoritative over Git/GitHub facts
assertions_evaluated.evidence: 'Verify GitHub's actual current state independently... never trust the stale recorded SHA, and never resolve by comparing timestamps' — explicit statement, and the described correction target is GitHub's current HEAD SHA, not a timestamp comparison.
